messages.subject: custom geom using circleGrob
parts:
Hi all,

Ive been trying to experiment on making custom geoms and I have been tinkering around geoms in ggplot2 to create a geom which plots a circle based on the center location and radius. However, the points and centers of the circles wont align. The circle might need some transformation but what am I missing?


   library(proto)
   library(ggplot2)

   x<-c(11.68, 17.26, 19.32)
   y<-c(2,4,6)
   df<-data.frame(x,y, sampno = 1:3)

   geom_circle <- function (mapping = NULL, data = NULL, stat = "identity", position = "identity", ...) {
           GeomMohr$new(mapping = mapping, data = data, stat = stat, position = position, ...)
   }

   GeomMohr <- proto(ggplot2:::Geom, {
          objname <- "circle"

         draw <- function(., data, scales, coordinates, ...) {
               with(coord_transform(coordinates, data, scales),
               ggname(.$my_name(), circleGrob(x, y))
    )
  }

  required_aes <- c("x", "y")
  default_aes <- function(.) aes(colour="black", fill = "grey50", size=0.5, alpha = NA)
  default_stat <- function(.) StatIdentity
  guide_geom <- function(.) "polygon"

})




ggplot(df,aes(y=y,x=x )) +  geom_circle() + geom_point()


Cheers,

Julius
